title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
description: Letters and journals record a struggle against a vampire’s spreading influence.

longDescription: Atmosphere matters as much as action: unsettling places, uncertainty and emotional intensity shape the experience. Questions of trust, belonging and the limits of human understanding give the story resonance beyond its suspense. Read for the gradually deepening mood without needing to know its surprises in advance.

authorInfo.bio: Abraham Stoker was an Irish writer, barrister, literary critic, and theatre manager. He was the author of the Gothic horror novel Dracula (1897) and the creator of the fictional character Count Dracula. The work and its antagonist are regarded as milestones in the fields of Gothic and vampire literature.
